description: Implementation of MerchantStore data access object (DAO) for database operations related to MerchantStore and associated products, using Hibernate and QueryDSL.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for MerchantStore, providing methods to retrieve products and merchant store details.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of products associated with a given merchant store, using HQL query with fetch joins.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore entity by its ID, using QueryDSL.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore by its code or ID, using QueryDSL.
